text: My day follows a consistent pattern, which helps me stay productive. I wake up at six-thirty every morning, and my first habit is drinking a glass of water before making coffee. After a quick shower, I review my to-do list for the day. By eight o’clock, I’m at my desk, starting work. I usually handle emails and meetings until lunchtime. In the afternoon, I focus on deep tasks that require concentration. At five, I finish work and head to the gym for a forty-minute workout—sometimes running, sometimes lifting weights. Evenings are for cooking a simple dinner, reading, or watching a show. I’m in bed by ten-thirty, ready to repeat the routine.
